scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ubiquiti-todo/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @ubiquiti-todo/server" "npm run dev -w @ubiquiti-todo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ubiquiti-todo/shared && npm run build -w @ubiquiti-todo/web && npm run build -w @ubiquiti-todo/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @ubiquiti-todo/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
